launchIssueAndFix.observed: After abrupt prior app stops, normal Finder/LaunchServices launch could leave a running process with no visible window; CLI open -a also logged task_name_for_pid failure and produced no process.
launchIssueAndFix.confirmedAppRuntimeCause: Stale Electron single-instance runtime artifacts (SingletonLock/SingletonCookie/SingletonSocket) from prior abrupt stops.
launchIssueAndFix.fixApplied: Removed only those runtime lock files under userData (not vault, config, database or ACL), then launched via Finder; alpha.22 window opened.
